originality.rationale: The source on the identical algebra (Farooq, arxiv:2605.15670, Theorem 3.4) is characteristic zero, when Tu=0. The newly evaluated modular case admits Tu≠0 and sharp index three; the dimension-uniform even-field rank distribution and GL(V) conjugacy stratification are not entailed by positive-characteristic spectral nilpotence (Gubarev, arxiv:2006.02654) or characteristic-zero general nilpotence (Gubarev, arxiv:1805.00723). Targeted published-finding corpus and web searches found only claims on different algebras or weaker properties. No historical uniqueness proof is asserted.
